D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ GLOR IA EXERC ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Trier mint, Reece period 17, RIC vol. 7 page 218 no. 556, issue of 333-334. In unusually good condition. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right, large eye, seen from front. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: two soldiers with two standards between them.
